system.description:
Once per Doom Quarter, use an Attack Action to Strike for 5 Shock damage at Medium Range (50 ft). If you hit and another enemy is within 20 ft, roll a CR 1 Smarts Check; on success the lightning chains to that enemy and damages it too. The chain can reach up to 5 more enemies.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.95
system.summary: Once per Doom Quarter, use an Attack Action to Strike for 5 Shock damage at Medium Range (50 ft). If you hit and another enemy is within 20 ft, roll a CR 1 Smarts Check; on success the lightning chains to that enemy and damages it too. The chain can reach up to 5 more enemies.

automation.note: Lightning Arc: if another enemy is within 20 ft, post the power to chat (speech-bubble icon), target that enemy and click the CR 1 Smarts roll button to chain to it.

automation.label: Chain to the next enemy
automation.onSuccess: The targeted enemy takes 5 Shock damage (Grit CR 1 or Stunned); the arc can jump again from it.

automation.note: Chain: after a hit, post this power to chat (speech-bubble icon), target one more enemy within 20 ft of the last one hit and click the Smarts roll button. Repeat for each jump, up to 5 extra enemies; the chain roll doesn't spend the power's use.
